framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 ("Takeover Regulations")
framework.note: Governs substantial acquisitions (≥5% of voting share capital) and formal takeover offers; mandatory disclosure and approval framework.
Requires acquirer to disclose the acquisition to the exchange within 24 hours of announcement or 6 days of public knowledge; triggers public phase of the takeover process.

framework.ref: RBI's Master Direction on Ownership Guidelines for Private Sector Banks, 2021 (as amended)
framework.note: Sets limits on voting shares in private banks; specifies individuals, corporate entities and foreign entities' shareholding caps; requires RBI approval for any acquisition crossing thresholds.

detail: DCB Bank Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), with the National Stock Exchange of India. This regulation mandates disclosure by an acquirer or offeror when a substantial acquisition (typically ≥5% of voting shares) occurs or a formal takeover offer is made. The filing appears to be a procedural regulatory notice; the identity of the acquirer, offer consideration, and shareholding details are not provided in the publicly available portions of this disclosure.
